name: b_ringdirty
prompt: Looking down into an ordinary white toilet bowl in a hotel bathroom, the seat up: a thick hard-water stain ring at the waterline, a rough crusty band of brown and rust-orange mineral deposit a finger wide with darker brown streaks running down toward the clear water, lit by the warm ceiling light. Framed so the ring crosses the frame in the middle third.

name: b_ringclean
prompt: Looking down into an ordinary white toilet bowl in a hotel bathroom, the seat up: the porcelain perfectly clean, bright white and glossy all the way around the waterline, clear water, lit by the warm ceiling light. Framed so the waterline crosses the frame in the middle third.

name: b_hotelbath
prompt: A mid-range hotel guest bathroom seen from the doorway at eye level: beige-cream ceramic wall tiles, a white toilet with the seat down, a white sink counter with a small amber soap bottle and folded white towels, a chrome towel bar, a wall mirror, warm ceiling light, beige tile floor. Nobody in the room.

name: b_hotelbath2
prompt: The corner of a mid-range hotel guest bathroom: beige-cream wall tiles, a white toilet beside a white bathtub with a folded white bath mat on its edge, a chrome grab bar, a small frosted window, warm ceiling light, beige tile floor. Nobody in the room.

name: b_counter
prompt: A white marble-look hotel bathroom counter at eye level: a white sink with a chrome faucet, folded white hand towels, a small amber soap bottle and a glass, beige-cream wall tiles and the edge of a mirror behind. Nobody in the room. Lots of empty counter space in the foreground.

name: b_desk
prompt: A hotel manager's office desk seen from above at a slight angle: a dark wooden desk with a leather desk pad, a pen, a coffee cup, a brass desk lamp and a telephone at the edges, lots of empty space in the middle. Warm office light.

name: b_tilewall
prompt: The lower part of a hotel bathroom wall behind a toilet, at knee height: beige-cream ceramic wall tiles with grout lines, the white side of the toilet base at the very left edge, a beige tile floor at the bottom. Plain empty wall in the middle of the frame. Warm ceiling light.

name: b_whitebowl
prompt: Looking down into a clean white porcelain toilet bowl, glossy and bright, clear water.

name: b_coloredtoilet
prompt: A pale pink colored toilet with a plastic seat in a dated bathroom, a gray pumice stone lying on the plastic seat.

name: b_wholetoilet
prompt: A whole white toilet with its tank seen straight on from the front at eye level in a hotel bathroom with beige-cream tiles, the seat and lid up so the inside of the bowl and the rim are visible, the tank lid on, centered in the frame with space around it.
